analysis: stratified analysis of ball-proposal recall on HUMAN_CONFIRMED_ADDITIONS

spatial.key_observation: in the TOP band human additions are LARGER (8.25px) than source GT (6.25px) yet recalled at 29.8% against 50.0%. Size does not explain the gap and position alone does not either.

claim_check.claim: the detector was trained to ignore these as non-in-play footballs
evidence: the source itself annotates non-active balls -- 22 existing annotations were human-confirmed as spare/ball-boy balls -- so there is no policy of exclusion to inherit
the detector RECALLS 50.0% of source GT in the same top band where it recalls only 29.8% of human additions, so it is not blind to that region
no training-set inspection was performed, and none of this evidence describes what the detector was trained on
claim_check.supported_alternative: a distribution/context shift: the human additions are drawn from a region and appearance regime under-represented in what the detector learned to call a football. The 20-point recall gap between source GT and human additions IN THE SAME BAND is the measurement; its cause is not established.
